dataset.domain: close-up macro photo of a vertical metal electrode solder joint, dark blurry background

classes.name: align
classes.description: aligned vertically stacked electrode, top and bottom electrode on the same vertical center axis, centered solder joint

classes.name: misalign
classes.description: misaligned vertically stacked electrode, top and bottom electrode on different vertical center axes, visible lateral offset at solder joint

generate.negative_prompt: horizontal alignment, side-by-side composition, two parallel lines, left and right objects, separate objects, duplicate, deformed, blurry background blobs, text, watermark
prompt_variations: different metallic surface texture, different solder shape, different reflections
different lighting direction, different exposure, different realistic solder coloration
different solder joint appearance, different highlights
slightly different camera position, different magnification, different depth of field
different color of oxidation and discoloration, different surface texture
